title: 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵
titlePy: Huáng Hè Lóu Sòng Mèng Hàorán Zhī Guǎnglíng
titleEn: Seeing Meng Haoran Off to Guangling at Yellow Crane Tower
author: 李白
intro: Li Bai waves goodbye to an older poet friend sailing down the Yangtze to Yangzhou in spring — and keeps watching until the sail disappears into the sky. A farewell poem that never says “goodbye” or “sad”.
analysis: 这首诗写李白在黄鹤楼送别好朋友孟浩然。孟浩然要坐船顺长江东下，去繁华的扬州（广陵）。前两句交代人物、地点和时间：“烟花三月”写出春天花开如烟、一片朦胧的美景，送别的季节很明亮。后两句只写一个画面：朋友的船越走越远，最后只剩一片小小的帆影，消失在蓝天尽头，眼前只有长江向天边流去。诗人一直站在楼上望着，没有一个字说“舍不得”，可是“望到看不见”这个动作本身就是深深的友情。这种把感情放进景物里的写法，叫“借景抒情”。“烟花三月下扬州”今天还常被用来形容春天去扬州旅游。
analysisEn: Li Bai is standing at Yellow Crane Tower in Wuhan, seeing off his friend Meng Haoran, a poet about twelve years older whom he admired. Meng is sailing east down the Yangtze to Guangling, the old name for Yangzhou, one of the richest and liveliest cities of the Tang dynasty. The first two lines give us who, where and when. “Smoke and flowers in the third month” paints late spring: blossoms everywhere, soft and hazy like mist. It is a bright, beautiful season for a farewell. The last two lines are a single long shot, like a film camera that never cuts away. The boat grows smaller, until only one lonely sail is left; then even that vanishes into the blue sky, and all that remains is the river flowing to the edge of heaven. Li Bai never says he is sad or that he will miss his friend. But think about what the picture tells you: he stood there watching until there was nothing left to see. Putting feelings into a scene instead of stating them is called “expressing emotion through scenery” (借景抒情), one of the most important habits of Chinese poetry. Today 烟花三月下扬州 is still quoted — and used in tourism slogans — whenever people talk about visiting Yangzhou in spring.
background: Li Bai (701–762) was in his late twenties, travelling along the Yangtze, when he met Meng Haoran (689–740), already a well-known poet. The farewell is traditionally dated to around 730. Yellow Crane Tower stands on the riverbank in today’s Wuhan.
pronunciation: “唯见”的“唯”有的版本作“惟”，读音相同（wéi）。题目中“之”是“去、往”的意思。其余无特殊读音。
version: 采用统编小学语文教材版本（“孤帆远影碧空尽”“唯见长江天际流”）。异文：一作“孤帆远影碧山尽”“惟见长江天际流”，网站不用。广陵即今江苏扬州。

lines.py: gù rén xī cí huáng hè lóu
lines.lit: My old friend, in the west, takes leave of Yellow Crane Tower;
lines.en: My old friend says goodbye at Yellow Crane Tower, here in the west,

lines.py: yān huā sān yuè xià yáng zhōu
lines.lit: amid misty blossoms in the third month, he goes down to Yangzhou.
lines.en: and sails down to Yangzhou in the third month, through a haze of blossoms.

lines.py: gū fān yuǎn yǐng bì kōng jìn
lines.lit: The lone sail, a distant shadow, ends in the blue sky;
lines.en: One small sail, a far-off shadow, fades into the blue —

lines.py: wéi jiàn cháng jiāng tiān jì liú
lines.lit: I only see the Long River flowing at the edge of the sky.
lines.en: now there is only the Yangtze, running on to the edge of the sky.

words.note: 古义是“老朋友”；现代汉语“故人”多指去世的人，要注意区别。

words.en: to take leave of; to say goodbye
words.note: 现代汉语“告辞”“辞别”的“辞”。
古义；现代汉语“烟花”指节日放的焰火，意思完全不同。

words.en: the third month of the lunar calendar (late spring)
words.note: 农历三月，大约是公历四月。

words.en: to go downstream; to go down to
words.note: 顺流而下。现代汉语“下江南”也这样用。

words.en: Yangzhou, a city on the lower Yangtze
words.note: 唐代最繁华的城市之一，即题目中的“广陵”。
孤：单独一个，现代汉语“孤单”“孤独”。
碧：青绿色、蓝色，现代汉语“碧绿”“碧蓝”。

words.en: to come to an end; to disappear
the edge of the sky; the horizon

imagery.name: 帆
imagery.zh: 一片越来越远的孤帆，就是诗人目送朋友的视线；“孤”字也透出送别的人心里的孤单。
imagery.en: The shrinking sail is the line of Li Bai’s gaze following his friend; the word “lone” hints at the loneliness of the one left behind.

imagery.name: 长江
imagery.zh: 朋友走了，江水还在不停地流，像诗人绵长的友情和思念。
imagery.en: The friend is gone, but the river keeps flowing — like a friendship and a longing that go on and on.
